content_origin: procedural geometry and analytic materials only; no photos, external meshes or pretrained weights

camera_conventions.c2w_storage: row-major 4x4; columns 0..2 are camera axes in world; column 3 is position
camera_conventions.pixel_coordinates: integer (u,v) are pixel centres; top-left centre=(0,0)
camera_conventions.vertical_fov: angle between top and bottom image edges, not between outermost pixel centres
camera_conventions.crf_pixel_equivalence: CRF samples at (x+0.5,y+0.5) in image-edge coordinates; integer-centre OpenCV K above is equivalent
camera_conventions.lens: pinhole, aperture=0, no distortion, global shutter
camera_conventions.image_array: top-to-bottom rows; PFM file storage is bottom-to-top and must be flipped when decoded

split.method: contiguous azimuth blocks withheld across all elevations; not random adjacent-frame splitting
split.guard_gap: none; boundary neighbours can be 9 degrees apart
split.lighting_split: same view labels for every lighting group; all lights are provided, not a held-out-light benchmark

geometry.geometry_scene_role: standalone CRF scene using first view and neutral_top lighting

beauty.meaning: linear RGB path-traced estimate before display filtering

albedo.meaning: first pinhole hit material color: diffuse reflectance for matte/ground; metal reflectance parameter for metal; Beer transmission per metre for glass; not universal diffuse albedo

normal.meaning: world-space face-forward first-hit surface/shading normal encoded n*0.5+0.5; no bump in this fixture; not camera-space normal

depth.meaning: first-hit normalized-ray distance t in metres repeated in RGB; not camera-Z; zero on miss

limitations: No rendering, training, GPU measurement or perceptual-quality claim has occurred.
The existing renderer is a prototype; its output is a reference implementation, not automatically physical ground truth.
Sphere geometry, camera matrices and declared material parameters are exact fixture inputs; transport remains a sampled numerical estimate.
Direct/indirect/specular separation required by advanced reflection research is not implemented in the existing renderer.
Camera and view split stay identical across lights; define an additional held-out lighting protocol before claiming relighting generalization.
